activities.title: Request Builder
activities.instruction: Build a REST request by selecting the HTTP method, endpoint, query parameters and headers.

content.concept: Understand how an HTTP request is composed from a method, URL, headers and optional body or query parameters.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Response Inspector
activities.instruction: Identify the status code, headers and JSON body in a simulated API response.

content.concept: Understand the main parts of an HTTP response and what status codes communicate.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Indicates that the request completed successfully.
Describes the format of the response content.
Contains structured data returned by the API.

activities.title: Fetch Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps required to fetch JSON data and render it in the UI.

content.concept: Use fetch to request data, convert the response to JSON and update the interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: API Debugger
activities.instruction: Inspect a failed request and identify whether the method, endpoint or response handling is incorrect.

content.concept: Debug common API request and response problems.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
